div.div: 5 تثلّل It (a house) became thrown down, or demolished; (K;) as also ↓ انثلّ : (TA:) or it (a house) became thrown down, or demolished, and it fell by degrees, part after part. (M.) And تَثَلَّلَتِ الرَّكِيَّةُ The well became demolished. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
